Pretty much all of us here know the way things are is unsustainable and must come to an end. I am interested in what your views and strategies of dealing with this are.

Specifically but not limited to the flowing issues:

  • How bad do you think it will get before it gets better again?
  • How long do you think will the transition period be?
  • What geographic areas will be most/least affected and where do you choose to live?
  • Which professions/industries will be most/least affected and what opportunities do you see?

My personal answers:

  • Given that most people in the west seem ignorant of the root problem I'm guessing it will get pretty bad, but not as bad as the collapse of communism.
  • I think between 5 and 10 years, but I wouldn't be surprised if it took longer.
  • I really don't know and have become a digital nomad. I guess I will see where the wind blows.
  • Very hard to predict with markets as badly distorted as they are. I am a computer programmer which I expect to hold up quite well but the amount of programmers doing public sector related things is unsettling.
What is your strategy for the coming years?

I really doubt there will be any kind of sudden collapse. I do think they have enough tricks up their sleeves to prevent it from happening. Instead we will get multi-decade recession (I'd say we're already 15 years in). Want to see what US will be like in 5-10 years? Look at Japan.

I don't think there will be a transition period, /u/capitalistchemist has a few posts talking about the stability of states. I am worried that the transition period will be a transition to something worse. For example can you imagine the US constitution being written by the current government? I can't.

In my opinion you should live wherever it makes sense for your short to medium term goals. For example if you got a job you like in Miami, you should move there without worrying about general societal trends. Nobody knows when the collapse (if it happens at all) will occur and if it does I think it's nearly impossible to tell where the best place to be is when it occurs.

In the United States?
